name: Poking again after an apology undoes it, and a second apology is fair
case: Boop is fed up from pokes. The person says sorry and Boop softens a step. Then they poke it four more times, and Boop is fed up again: the apology didn't hold, so it's irritated or grumpy. Only now does a second apology make sense, and Boop softens a step again. This is the rare case where saying sorry twice is needed: the person undid the first one.
why: The owner's brief of 2026-09-29: one apology should do, apart from specific cases like this. characters/boop/steering/mood/: saying sorry moves grumpy to irritated or annoyed and irritated to annoyed; 3+ pokes in a row move annoyed to irritated, and 4+ irritated to grumpy

steps.words: okay, I really mean it this time. sorry, buddy
